metadata.title: High-Contrast Noir Portrait with Vertical Slab Serif

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key monochrome portrait featuring a subject in shadow with bold, vertically-oriented slab serif typography on the right margin.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white album cover
low key lighting with slab serif

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, low-key black and white portrait where the subject is mostly obscured by deep shadows, accented by sharp highlights on skin texture and accessories, paired with stark white vertical typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left two-thirds in deep shadow
Typography is anchored to the right vertical axis
High-contrast highlights define the subject's silhouette
Negative space is pure black to emphasize white text
coreInvariants: Monochrome color palette with absolute black and pure white
Vertical orientation of the primary text block
Low-key lighting with high-frequency detail in highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is off-center to the left, cropped from the chest up, filling most of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white vertical text on the right serves as the primary visual anchor against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright text on the right, moves left to the subject's highlights (glasses, cigar, jewelry), and then follows the vertical line of the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of deep black negative space to create a 'noir' atmosphere and isolate the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between deep blacks and bright whites.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with blocky terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying scales for primary and secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif and blocky terminals.
Provides the necessary geometric slab serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, low-key black and white portrait of a person in shadows, wearing sunglasses and jewelry, with a dark background and sharp highlights on textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical, uppercase slab serif text in solid white along the right edge of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the text oriented vertically on the right?
Is the lighting low-key with deep shadows?
Is the font a heavy slab serif?

postGenerationChecks: Check for absolute black levels in background
Verify text legibility in vertical orientation
Ensure no color bleed or tinting
Confirm slab serif terminals are sharp and blocky
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key B&W Portrait + Vertical Slab Serif Typography = Noir Urban Aesthetic
